macros.name: DTMcentury
macros.doc: This converts 〈year〉 to the century.

macros.name: DTMclearmap
macros.doc: Undefines the given zone mapping.

macros.name: DTMdialecttomodulemap
macros.doc: This expands to the required module name or \relax if the given dialect name wasn’t used to load a module.

macros.name: DTMdisplaydate
macros.doc: The format used to display the date is governed by the display style. The arguments are all numerical: 〈year〉 is the year, 〈month〉 is the month number (starting from 1 for January), 〈day〉 is the day of the month and 〈dow〉 is the day of the week number starting from 0 for Monday.

macros.name: DTMfetchday
macros.doc: This expands to the day of the month.

macros.name: DTMfetchdow
macros.doc: This expands to the day of the week number (-1 if unknown).

macros.name: DTMfetchhour
macros.doc: This expands to the hour.

macros.name: DTMfetchminute
macros.doc: This expands to the minute.

macros.name: DTMfetchmonth
macros.doc: This expands to the month number.

macros.name: DTMfetchsecond
macros.doc: This expands to the second.

macros.name: DTMfetchTZhour
macros.doc: This expands to the hour offset.

macros.name: DTMfetchTZminute
macros.doc: This expands to the minute offset.

macros.name: DTMfetchyear
macros.doc: This expands to the year.

macros.name: DTMfinaldot
macros.doc: This command is simply defined as “.” but it’s locally redefined to do nothing by the starred versions of \DTMdate and \DTMDate allowing the dot to be discarded.

macros.name: DTMhaszonemap
macros.doc: This will do 〈true〉 if there is a mapping defined for that time zone or 〈false〉 otherwise.

macros.name: DTMifhasdatestyle
macros.doc: Test to determine if partial date style exists.

macros.name: DTMifhasstyle
macros.doc: If the (full) style given by 〈name〉 exists, this does 〈true〉 otherwise it does 〈false〉.

macros.name: DTMifhastimestyle
macros.doc: Test to determine if time style exists.

macros.name: DTMifhaszonestyle
macros.doc: Test to determine if time zone style exists.

macros.name: DTMifsaveddate
macros.doc: Determine if the given label has been assigned to a date, time and zone.

macros.name: DTMlangsetup
macros.doc: This will set the 〈option list〉 for each module listed in 〈module-name list〉.

macros.name: DTMlangsetup
macros.doc: This will set the 〈option list〉 for each module listed in 〈module-name list〉.

macros.name: DTMlangsetup*
macros.doc: This will set the 〈option list〉 for each module listed in 〈module-name list〉.

macros.name: DTMlangsetup*
macros.doc: This will set the 〈option list〉 for each module listed in 〈module-name list〉.

macros.name: DTMNatoZoneMaps
macros.doc: This defines the military/NATO mappings from A (Alpha time) to Z (Zulu time).

macros.name: DTMnewdatestyle
macros.doc: This defines a partial style that should only modify \DTMdisplaydate and \DTMDisplaydate.

arg.snippet: DTMnewstyle{${1:name}}{${2:date style definition}}{${3:time style definition}}{${4:zone style definition}}{${5:full style definition}}

macros.name: DTMnewtimestyle
macros.doc: This defines a partial style that should only modify \DTMdisplaytime.

macros.name: DTMnewzonestyle
macros.doc: This defines a partial style that should only modify \DTMdisplayzone.

macros.name: DTMnow
macros.doc: Current date, time and time zone.

macros.name: DTMNow
macros.doc: Current date, time and time zone.

macros.name: DTMprovidedatestyle
macros.doc: This defines the named date style. This won’t do anything if either a partial date style or a full style with the given name already exists.

macros.name: DTMprovidestyle

arg.snippet: DTMprovidestyle{${1:name}}{${2:date style definition}}{${3:time style definition}}{${4:zone style definition}}{${5:full style definition}}

macros.doc: This defines the named full style if the named full style doesn’t already exist.

macros.name: DTMprovidetimestyle
macros.doc: This defines the named time style. This won’t do anything if either a partial time style or a full style with the given name already exists.

macros.name: DTMrenewdatestyle
macros.doc: This redefines the named date style.

macros.name: DTMrenewstyle

arg.snippet: DTMrenewstyle{${1:name}}{${2:date style definition}}{${3:time style definition}}{${4:zone style definition}}{${5:full style definition}}

macros.doc: This redefines the named full style.

macros.name: DTMrenewtimestyle
macros.doc: This redefines the named time style.

macros.name: DTMrenewzonestyle
macros.doc: This redefines the named time zone style.

macros.name: DTMsavetimezn
macros.doc: Save the time (including zone) specified in the format 〈hh〉:〈mm〉:〈ss〉 〈tzh〉:〈tzm〉.

macros.name: DTMsep
macros.doc: This accesses the value of the 〈tag〉sep base package option.

macros.name: DTMsetdatestyle
macros.doc: This will just change the date style (\DTMdisplaydate and \DTMDisplaydate), not the time or zone styles.

macros.name: DTMsettimestyle
macros.doc: This will just change the time style (\DTMdisplaytime), not the date or zone styles.

macros.name: DTMsetzonestyle
macros.doc: This will just change the zone style (\DTMdisplayzone), not the date or time styles.

macros.name: DTMtexorpdfstring
macros.doc: If hyperref is loaded, this is equivalent to \texorpdfstring otherwise it just does the first argument and ignores the second.

macros.name: DTMtwodigits
macros.doc: This displays 〈number〉 so that it has exactly two digits.

macros.name: DTMuse
macros.doc: Displays the previously saved date and time.

macros.name: DTMUse
macros.doc: Displays the previously saved date and time.

macros.name: DTMusedate
macros.doc: Displays the previously saved date using \DTMdisplaydate.

macros.name: DTMUsedate
macros.doc: Displays the previously saved date using \DTMDisplaydate.

macros.name: DTMusetime
macros.doc: Displays the previously saved time using \DTMdisplaytime.

macros.name: DTMusezonemap
macros.doc: This expands to the time zone abbreviation or \relax if no mapping has been set for the given time zone.

macros.name: DTMusezonemapordefault
macros.doc: This will use the mapping if its defined otherwise it will expand to the format 〈TZh〉〈HMsep〉〈TZm〉 where 〈HMsep〉〈TZm〉 is omitted if the option showzoneminutes is set to false.
